halt.detail: The worktree isolation guard refuses the check command. The command was run exactly as dispatched, `./flightdeck/flightcrew/bin/fc check T12 T30 T38 T28 T31 T54 --launch flightcrew-characterization-1`, with the working directory confirmed as the worktree root (pwd and git rev-parse --show-toplevel both return /Users/dylangraham/Projects/flightdeck/.claude/worktrees/agent-a077a665aef6878e4). The guard's refusal: 'this command runs a string through fc, which can't be verified to stay inside the worktree. Refusing to run it — a worktree-isolated agent's git operations must target its own worktree.' Without a way to run the checks, no change can be proven green. I did not try to get around it by calling the check scripts directly or reading their source.

notes: No files were edited and nothing was committed. The only change is the new branch flightcrew-characterization-1/contracts, created from 0c5e8c4 and left in place. To continue, the permission setup must allow a worktree-isolated agent to run ./flightdeck/flightcrew/bin/fc check; then this unit can be dispatched again.
